locked.title: Compliance language is locked
locked.body: The AI disclosure, recording notice and emergency safety guidance are added by Vireek outside your scripts. Experiments can never remove, hide or override them — the database rejects script text that tries.

settings.title: Voice Autopilot
settings.intro: Autopilot tests one change at a time on a small share of calls and only promotes a winner when the evidence and every safety check agree.
settings.modeAuto: Auto — promote winners within the limits below
settings.modeNote: In every mode, a safety problem rolls the challenger back automatically.
settings.maxTraffic: Most traffic a test may use
settings.autoNote: Emergency and complaint scripts are never promoted automatically.
settings.pooled: Share anonymous baseline rates to help small businesses learn faster
settings.pooledHint: Only counts from your untouched (control) calls are shared — no names, numbers, recordings or text. Used only when at least 10 other businesses have contributed. You can turn this off at any time.

dimensionHelp: Each test changes ONE thing, so you know what caused the result.

pace.note: Pace is applied as speaking guidance in the prompt; your voice provider settings are not changed.

metric.time_to_book_seconds: Call length when booked (time to book)

metricNote.abandon_rate: Counted as a call of 15 seconds or less that did not book.
metricNote.time_to_book_seconds: Uses the length of calls that ended with a booking.
metricNote.emergency_detection_accuracy: Only calls with a confirmed emergency label are counted. Without labels there is no result.
metricNote.latency_ms: Per-call latency is not recorded yet, so this safety check must be waived explicitly.

start.title: Start a pre-registered test
start.intro: Everything below is locked when you start, so the result can't be bent afterwards.
start.variantUntagged: Version {{n}} — not tagged with what changed
start.needTag: Save the challenger from the Editor with “What does this version change?” selected so the test changes one thing only.
start.name: Test name
start.hypothesis: What do you expect, and why? (optional)
start.maxN: Calls per side before the test ends
start.maxNSuggested: Suggested: {{n}} calls per side to reliably detect a {{pts}}-point change.
start.waiveLatency: I accept that response latency is not measured for this test
start.waiveLatencyHint: Complaints, escalations and compliance flags are always measured and can never be waived.
start.plan: Plan: {{n}} calls per side, checked at {{looks}} calls per side. A winner can only be declared at those checkpoints.
start.lockRejected: That version changes compliance language that is locked. Edit it and try again.

feasibility.notEnoughBody: At about {{perDay}} calls a day per side this test needs roughly {{days}} days. Collecting data is fine, but no conclusion is possible before then.
feasibility.cannot: This test probably can't conclude in time
feasibility.cannotBody: Detecting a {{pts}}-point change needs about {{n}} calls per side, which at your call volume would take longer than {{max}} days. Choose a larger change to look for, or test fewer things. We will not declare a winner on too little data.
feasibility.ok: At your call volume this should finish in about {{days}} days.

live.title: Running: {{name}}
live.evaluated: Checked. Winners are only declared at the planned checkpoints.
live.progress: {{n}} of {{target}} calls on the smaller side
live.descriptiveNote: These running numbers are for information only. Decisions are made only at the planned checkpoints, which prevents “peeking” from fooling us.
live.intervalLabel: Effect at the last checkpoint: {{estimate}} points (range {{low}} to {{high}})
live.intervalNote: The range is widened on purpose because we looked more than once.
live.pending: {{n}} still waiting to be saved · {{m}} excluded (voicemail, spam, missed, a different scenario, or not finished). “Booked” means the call ended with a booking.
live.approvalTitle: A winner is ready for your approval
live.approvalBody: The challenger beat the live version at the planned checkpoint and every safety check passed. Nothing changes until you approve.
live.approveFailed: Could not promote. Please try again.
live.stopBody: All calls go back to the live version. Results so far are kept in the history.

reason.no_significant_difference_at_final_look: No clear difference after the full sample.
reason.significant_and_guardrails_pass: Clear improvement and every safety check passed.
reason.effect_below_minimum: The improvement is smaller than the minimum you set.
reason.critical_compliance_flag: A serious compliance problem was found on a challenger call.
reason.lock_violation: The challenger text touches locked compliance language.
reason.guardrail_unknown: {{metric}} has no data, so safety can't be confirmed.

guardrail.title: Safety checks
guardrail.pending: Needs at least 30 calls per side

history.title: Test history
history.diffNone: The two versions have identical text.

audit.title: Change log
audit.intro: Every change to what callers hear is recorded with who or what made it. This log cannot be edited.
audit.script_pointer_changed: Live version or traffic split changed
audit.experiment_inconclusive: Test ended without a clear result

report.title: What improved this week
report.win: {{name}} ({{dimension}}) improved {{metric}} by {{estimate}} points (range {{low}} to {{high}}) on {{n}} calls per side. {{action}}
report.winAwaiting: It is waiting for your approval.
report.loss: {{name}} ({{dimension}}) made {{metric}} worse (about {{estimate}} points, range {{low}} to {{high}}). We stopped it and kept the live version.
report.inconclusive: {{name}} ({{dimension}}) showed no clear difference after {{n}} calls per side. Nothing changed.
report.rollback: {{name}} ({{dimension}}) was rolled back automatically because a safety check failed.
report.running: {{name}} ({{dimension}}) is still collecting data: {{n}} of {{target}} calls per side. We won’t draw conclusions yet.
report.learning_no_experiments: No tests ran this week, so there is nothing new to report.
report.learning_low_volume: There weren’t enough calls to conclude anything. That is normal for a small business — it just means we can’t say yet.
report.learning_all_inconclusive: Nothing we tried moved the numbers. That is useful: your current script is holding its own.
report.limit_sequential_intervals: Ranges are deliberately wide because each test is checked at several planned points.
report.limit_early_stop_inflation: Tests that stop early tend to overstate the improvement. Expect the real gain to be somewhat smaller.
report.limit_heuristic_metrics: Some measures are approximations (for example, hang-ups are calls of 15 seconds or less that did not book).

qa.title: Staff call QA
qa.intro: Scores calls handled by your team on greeting, discovery, booking ask, price handling, empathy and compliance, with the exact moments that earned each score.
qa.policyTitle: How these scores may be used
qa.policy: Scores are a coaching aid, not a verdict. They come from an automatic checklist that can be wrong. They must not be used for discipline, pay or termination unless a person has listened to the call and confirmed the review.
qa.offBody: Nothing is scored until the account owner turns this on.
qa.ack: I have told my team how call scores are used and I accept this policy.
qa.transparency: Let each team member see their own scores and coaching
qa.transparencyHint: They see only their own reviews, never colleagues’.
qa.ownerOnly: Only the account owner can change these settings.
qa.ran: Scored {{scored}} calls; {{skipped}} skipped (no usable two-sided transcript).
qa.emptyBody: Calls handled by a team member with a transcript appear here after scoring.
qa.mixSensitive: For {{names}} the ranking changes a lot once the mix of calls (e.g. complaints vs. new inquiries) is accounted for. Do not compare these people on the raw average.
qa.languageGap: Scores differ by {{gap}} points between {{a}} and {{b}} callers. Check whether the checklist treats these conversations fairly before drawing conclusions.
qa.fairnessOk: No fairness warnings with the data we have.
qa.confirm: I listened and confirm this review

coach.greet_with_name: Open with a greeting and your name.
coach.ask_more_discovery_questions: Ask two or three more questions about the problem before moving on.
coach.ask_for_the_booking: Offer a specific appointment time instead of ending without a next step.
coach.route_price_to_estimate: When asked about price, explain that the estimate depends on the job and offer a visit.
coach.acknowledge_feelings: When the caller is stressed, acknowledge it in one sentence before problem-solving.
coach.state_recording_notice: Say the recording notice at the start of the call.
coach.avoid_guarantees: Avoid promises of price or outcome you can’t guarantee.

empty.publishTitle: Publish a version to start testing
empty.publishBody: A test compares a challenger against the version that is live now. Publish a version from the Editor first.
empty.secondTitle: Save a second version to test
empty.secondBody: Edit your script in the Editor and save it as a new version, then come back.

editor.dimension: What does this version change? (for A/B tests)
editor.dimensionHelp: Pick the ONE thing you changed so a test can tell what worked. Compliance wording can never be changed.
